facts.claim: 22 June 2026 (Canberra): Secretary of State Stephen Fuhr announced formal arrangements with Australia and BAE Systems Australia for OTHR capability supporting A-OTHR.
Signed: Government-to-Government Acquisition Arrangement (Fuhr–Marles); OTHR Rights Agreement with Australia and BAE Systems Australia; comprehensive ITB agreement with BAE Systems Australia.
Canada is committed to spending $2.5 billion with Australia to procure this capability. BAE Systems Australia scheduled to begin work 1 July 2026; IOC commitment by December 2029.
18 March 2025: Prime Minister announced plan to invest more than $6 billion in the A-OTHR program (overall program class).
facts.source: quick facts on same release; PM release linked

facts.claim: Economic class stated: ~$290M annual GDP contribution and ~2,270 jobs annually 2026–2033 (government economic claim — report as stated, not independently audited here).

mode_update: G2G_PARTNER_PROCUREMENT_WITH_STATED_2_5B_AU_SPEND — not classic commercial sole-source RFP; still a non-competitive partner path relative to open multi-bidder commercial AEW-style contest.
